findings.why: The measured Rp0.2 of 245 MPa on the Alluminio B BR-220 lot is below the 250 MPa minimum of SC-01 in drawing Rev C and control plan CP-BR220-R3, which are in force. The control plan reaction is to quarantine the heat and notify the Supplier Quality Engineer.
